extracted.intended_audience: potential grant applicants / partner organizations seeking JSMF funding (especially projects in St. Louis)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for organizations preparing proposals to the James S. McDonnell Foundation, with emphasis on geographic and topical fit. Focus is on aligning proposals with JSMF's priority of advancing economic mobility for St. Louisans facing the greatest disparities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with JSMF priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The James S. McDonnell Foundation (JSMF) directs its resources toward initiatives that advance economic mobility for St. Louisans facing the starkest disparities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrably advance economic mobility for St. Louis residents who experience the most severe disparities; alignment with this mission is the primary selection criterion implied by the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference background information about funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage potential partners to reference background information about our funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult and reference the foundation's background/funding-opportunity materials (linked on the site) to ensure their proposal matches program goals, eligibility, and any stated priorities or application procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectation about communications and review
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that we are unable to respond to every message due to the high volume of submissions. JSMF will review your submission and, if appropriate, contact you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should not expect individual confirmations or feedback for every inquiry; submissions will be screened and only those deemed appropriate will receive follow-up from the foundation.
